act_range.description: Observed 0x18-byte ACT kernel-range record. Its relocation selects code in KernelText; the +0x0c extent is an execution-tested inference for this supported carrier family.

act_invocation.description: Observed 0x40-byte ACT invocation record. Its +0 word selects a range in the supported compiler family; other decoded words remain carrier-specific where noted.

code_image.description: Exact KernelText byte slice selected by a range relocation addend and the observed range extent.

rela.description: Standard ELF64 Rela entry connecting a field in the target section to a symbol plus an addend.

parameter_block.description: KernelParams slice selected by an ACT invocation relocation. It contains consecutive tensor descriptors followed by their shape and stride data.

memref.description: Observed 0x28-byte tensor descriptor used by npunlock to validate address space, static shape, element type, dense strides, and input/output separation.

dimension_array.description: Signed 32-bit dimension extents referenced by a MemRefData descriptor.

stride_array.description: Signed 64-bit tensor strides in bits, referenced by a MemRefData descriptor.

compatibility.description: Semicolon-delimited native-graph compatibility requirements checked before npunlock accepts the carrier.

version_note.description: Fixed ELF note whose owner, type, and four-component version gate the supported loader or mapped-inference contract.

platform_info.description: Five-word platform record whose exact supported values are validated for the NPU3720 carrier family.

dma_task.description: Observed 0x80-byte NPU3720 DMA task. npunlock uses its endpoints, byte extent, geometry, and barrier fields to prove graph input/output and intermediate routing.

dpu_invariant.description: Observed 0x130-byte DPU invariant. npunlock decodes selected tensor-shape, type, address-relocation, and scheduling fields for ACT/DPU routing checks.

fields.description: Raw range word at +0x00; npunlock preserves it and does not claim a general meaning.
SHAVE virtual address recorded for this range's executable image.
Relocation-backed reference field targeting the KernelText section.
Observed executable extent at record +0x0c; its bounding role is an execution-tested inference.
Raw range word at +0x10; preserved but not interpreted by npunlock.
Raw range word at +0x14; preserved but not interpreted by npunlock.
Zero-based ACT range selector, confirmed for the supported compiler family.
Relocation-backed reference to this invocation's KernelParams base.
Relocation-backed data-reference field; its detailed ABI remains carrier-specific.
First raw word in an invariant byte slice used, with other fields, to group compiler-8.3 invocation replicas. It has no standalone public ABI meaning.
Raw barrier wait mask used by npunlock's routing analysis to connect scheduled producers and consumers.
Raw barrier post mask used by npunlock's routing analysis to connect this invocation to later work.
Raw barrier-group byte retained by routing inspection.
Raw barrier-mask byte retained by routing inspection.
Raw scheduler bytes inside the invocation identity slice; preserved without a standalone semantic claim.
Raw scheduler word inside the invocation identity slice; preserved without a standalone semantic claim.
Raw scheduling value exposed as start-after by npunlock routing inspection.
Raw scheduling value exposed as clean-after by npunlock routing inspection.
Raw record word at +0x30 exposed for diagnosis; no general semantic contract is claimed.
Raw +0x34 value that strongly correlates with tile selection; exact relocation semantics remain open.
Raw record word at +0x38 exposed for diagnosis; no general semantic contract is claimed.
Final raw word used with the invariant +0x0c..+0x2f slice to group compiler-generated invocation replicas.
Relocation-backed 32-bit tensor data address. npunlock resolves its CMX symbol and addend rather than trusting the stored placeholder.
Upper or companion data-address word. The public kernel helper uses the low 32-bit relocated address; npunlock preserves this word.
Must equal 1 for the static tensor contract accepted by npunlock.
Number of dimension and stride entries. npunlock accepts ranks 1 through 15.
Relocation-backed pointer to signed 32-bit dimension extents in KernelParams.
Relocation-backed pointer to signed 64-bit strides, measured in bits, in KernelParams.
Observed element-type code used to derive element width and validate the custom-kernel contract.
Carrier-specific tensor word at +0x1c; preserved without a general meaning.
Carrier-specific tensor word at +0x20; preserved without a general meaning.
Memory-kind code; npunlock requires the observed CMX value 2 for patchable tensors.
Positive tensor dimension extent.
Tensor stride in bits; dense validation orders non-singleton dimensions by this value.
ELF note owner-name size; the supported contract uses four bytes.
ELF note description size; four 32-bit version components occupy 16 bytes.
Vendor note type checked for the named compatibility section.
Four-byte ELF note owner identifier.
Major version component.
Minor version component.
Patch version component.
Build or fourth version component.
Supported platform-contract word 0; npunlock currently requires 0x20 but does not expose a broader semantic claim.
Supported platform-contract word 1; npunlock currently requires zero.
Supported platform-contract word 2; npunlock currently requires one.
Supported platform-contract word 3; npunlock currently requires eight.
Supported platform-contract word 4; npunlock currently requires three.
Raw DMA configuration word; its low two bits select the supported transfer form.
Relocation-backed DMA source value. npunlock resolves its endpoint kind, symbol, and addend.
Relocation-backed DMA destination value. npunlock resolves its endpoint kind, symbol, and addend.
Transfer extent in bytes; zero-length tasks are rejected.
Packed plane count in the low byte and task identifier in the upper 24 bits.
Raw signed source plane stride used by routing validation.
Raw signed destination plane stride used by routing validation.
For transfer type 0 this is the post mask; type 1 instead packs source width and signed source stride here.
For transfer type 0 this is the wait mask; type 1 instead packs destination width and signed destination stride here.
Source row width for transfer type 1; overlaps the type-0 post-mask storage.
Signed source row stride for transfer type 1; overlaps the type-0 post-mask storage.
Destination row width for transfer type 1; overlaps the type-0 wait-mask storage.
Signed destination row stride for transfer type 1; overlaps the type-0 wait-mask storage.
Barrier post mask for transfer type 1; not interpreted for type 0.
Barrier wait mask for transfer type 1; not interpreted for type 0.
Raw start-after scheduling value.
Raw clean-after scheduling value.
Packed kernel/padding configuration; bit 15 is used to require dense input storage.
Packed input X and Y extents used to derive the dense input span.
Packed input Z extent used to derive the dense input span.
Packed input tensor mode; bits 4..7 select the input element type used by routing validation.
Packed output type, density, and sparsity configuration used to validate a byte-addressable output.
Packed output Y and Z extents, stored minus one.
Packed output X extent, stored minus one.
Raw barrier wait mask used by ACT/DPU routing analysis.
Raw barrier post mask used by ACT/DPU routing analysis.
Raw barrier-group byte.
Raw barrier-mask byte.
Raw start-after scheduling value.
Raw clean-after scheduling value.
Number of associated DPU variants; zero is rejected.
NPU tile or cluster index; it must be below the compatibility tile count.
Offset within the relocation section's target section.
Symbol-table index encoded in the Rela information word.
Relocation type encoded in the Rela information word.
Signed constant addend applied by the relocation.

section_descriptions..text.KernelText: Executable SHAVE code storage. ACT range relocations select byte slices within this section.
section_descriptions..text.KernelData: Kernel-associated data storage; this viewer does not infer an ABI for its contents.
section_descriptions..text.KernelParams: Relocation-selected ACT tensor descriptors plus referenced dimension and stride arrays. Decoding is limited to the validated compiler-8.3 MemRefData contract.
section_descriptions..text.ActKernelRanges: Observed 0x18-byte ACT range records that reference executable slices in KernelText.
section_descriptions..text.ActKernelInvocations: Observed 0x40-byte ACT invocation records that connect scheduled work to ranges and parameters.
section_descriptions..text.actKernelRtConfigSec: ACT runtime configuration storage referenced by the mapped-inference schedule; its remaining carrier-specific layout is not required for code substitution.
section_descriptions..text.dmaTasks0: Observed 0x80-byte DMA tasks for engine 0. npunlock inspects their endpoints, extents, geometry, and barriers when proving routing.
section_descriptions..text.BarrierConfigs: Barrier configuration records used by the native schedule; relocations and scheduling masks connect task ordering.
section_descriptions..text.MappedInference: Mapped-inference schedule data that references DMA, DPU, ACT, and barrier tasks.
section_descriptions..text.DPUInvariants: Observed 0x130-byte DPU invariant records used to derive dense input/output extents and ACT/DPU relationships.
section_descriptions..text.DPUVariants: DPU variant records associated with DPU invariants; npunlock preserves them and inspects their schedule relationships.
section_descriptions..metadata: Compiler-emitted native graph metadata. It remains opaque to the patch operation and is preserved byte-for-byte.
section_descriptions..perf.metrics: Compiler-emitted performance metric records preserved by npunlock; they are not used to authorize patching.
section_descriptions..data.ConstIO: File-backed constant and graph-I/O data storage referenced through ELF symbols and DMA relocations.
section_descriptions..note.LoaderABIVersion: Version note for the native loader ABI accepted by npunlock's supported carrier contract.
section_descriptions..note.MappedInferenceVersion: Version note for the mapped-inference ABI accepted by npunlock's supported carrier contract.
section_descriptions..meta.PlatformInfo: Fixed NPU platform-contract record checked before patching.
section_descriptions.compatibility_string: Compiler, NPU, tile-count, loader, and mapped-inference compatibility tokens checked before patching.

compatibility_fields.compiler: Native graph compiler version. npunlock's current carrier parser requires compiler 8.3.
compatibility_fields.npu: NPU architecture identifier. The current supported target is NPU3720.
compatibility_fields.t: Compiler-selected tile count. It bounds every ACT invocation's tile index.
compatibility_fields.elf: Native loader ELF ABI version required by the carrier.
compatibility_fields.mi: Mapped-inference ABI version required by the carrier.
